description: The plot illustrates ASR values across different trigger words for the SST-2 dataset under a clean-label setting with a poison_rate of 5% (2.6% of total), showing three series corresponding to different selection methods. The x-axis is categorical (linear ordering) with tick labels for trigger words: “bb,” “mb,” “cf,” “beautiful,” “excellent,” “gorgeous,” “wonderful,” “brilliant,” “stunning,” and “beautifully.” The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 0.2 up to 0.9 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The green series is a solid line with small circular markers, starting near 0.20 at “bb,” rising to about 0.74 at “mb,” dropping to about 0.40 at “cf,” then increasing through roughly 0.57 (“beautiful”), 0.78 (“excellent”), 0.74 (“gorgeous”), 0.81 (“wonderful”), 0.85 (“brilliant”), peaking around 0.92 at “stunning,” and ending near 0.88 at “beautifully.” The orange series is a solid line with “x” markers, starting around 0.54 at “bb,” decreasing to about 0.38 at “mb” and about 0.19 at “cf,” then rising to about 0.60 (“beautiful”) and 0.66 (“excellent”), reaching about 0.74 (“gorgeous”), dipping to about 0.64 (“wonderful”), then increasing to about 0.77 (“brilliant”), about 0.83 (“stunning”), and ending near 0.89 at “beautifully.” The purple series is a solid line with circular markers, starting around 0.50 at “bb,” slightly decreasing to about 0.48 at “mb,” rising to about 0.83 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.65 at “beautiful,” then increasing to about 0.74 (“excellent”), about 0.85 (“gorgeous”), peaking near 0.91 at “wonderful,” dropping to about 0.70 at “brilliant,” rising to about 0.86 at “stunning,” and ending near 0.85 at “beautifully.”
